description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal Views block plugins, handling view loading, caching, access control, configuration, and contextual links.

classes.name: ViewsBlockBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for Drupal Views block plugins, including view management, caching, access control, configuration, and contextual links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads the view and sets up the display and user context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts for the view display.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags for the view display.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age for the view display.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for the view based on the current user.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block.

methods.name: getPreviewFallbackString
methods.description: Returns a fallback string for preview mode, using admin label or view label.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the block, allowing override of the view title.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the block configuration form.

methods.name: addContextualLinks
methods.description: Adds contextual links to the block output.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Indicates whether to create a placeholder for the block.
